regime: Metals steadying near lows while tech futures rebound
takeaway: Gold and silver edged up overnight from 14-month lows, but the gold/silver ratio is still above 82 and gold is down about 9% in a month, so the site's silver-under-stress and gold-downtrend checks still match. Yesterday's forced-selling pattern is not repeating so far. Nasdaq futures were up about 2% ahead of Anthropic's market debut, while the 10-year yield sits near 5.06% and the dollar stays close to a 19-month high.
